channel.title: Capture Verification Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Capture Verification

item.title: Version 3.2.20260419
item.description:
What's New in 3.2

🔗 Capture One Integration

  • Process missing files directly — click "Process in C1" on any missing file to send it to Capture One's batch queue
  • Recipe picker — select from your available process recipes; choice persists for the session
  • Process All in C1 — batch-process all missing files in a folder with one click
  • Re-check button — lightweight verification of just the missing files after processing, no full re-scan needed

📂 Subfolder Context

  • Missing files in View/Resolve are now grouped by subfolder
  • Subfolder rows show missing file counts (e.g., "Captures: 252 · Output: 251 · 1 missing")
  • Show in Finder navigates to the correct subfolder
  • Subfolder status updates live when files are resolved

⚠️ Naming Anomaly Improvements

  • Fixed false positives — pattern detection now runs per-subfolder
  • Warnings now show expected vs actual naming prefix
  • Show in Finder button added next to each warning
  • Warnings grouped by subfolder

🐞 Diagnostic Logging

  • New diagnostic logging for debugging OS-specific issues (e.g., macOS Tahoe)
  • Enable in Settings → Advanced
  • File access errors tracked and surfaced in results header
  • Export logs from the results screen

📄 PDF Reports

  • Missing files listed individually with subfolder grouping
  • Subfolder breakdown in folder sections
  • macOS version in report header

Other

  • macOS version displayed in results header
  • Summary cards update live when issues are resolved
  • Improved file enumeration error handling
